quote: Why does every single work email need to start with hope this finds you well? It finds me staring at a blank spreadsheet questioning my entire life choices. Then someone schedules a meeting that literally could have just been a text. And now I am nodding on a video call pretending I understand the Q3 projections. Anyway I will probably do it all again tomorrow because I like having electricity.
